For rank r of T, the nilpotent two-block module structures yield H=m³−m²r−mr²+2r³ allowable S. The induced quotient map ker(T)/im(T)→ker(U)/im(U) is surjective with constant q^(H−ab) fibers; rank(Φ)=r(r+1)+s. Gaussian counts of T and rank-s quotient maps prove the stated polynomial for every finite field and attainable-rank union over any field. Independent arithmetic evaluation of m=2 q=2,3 agrees with counts 1+45z+258z² and 1+320z+6888z². Missing ranks 9–11 for m=6 follow exactly from the union r(r+1)+[0,m−2r].
